steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Change the default event type from RFP to RFQ.
Choose the offered RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product to the first sheet row.
Verify the quantity was retained in the sheet.
Verify the product's automatically populated variant.

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, open Price Components, add a component named Freight, save it, and stop on the sheet showing Freight as an extra vendor price part with the totals including that component.

steps.note: Perform and verify the Price Components interaction, which has no dedicated domain step.
Assert that the saved Freight component is visible on the pricing sheet.
